tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall contract with the National Academy of Sciences to conduct a study of energy subsidies that—

children.text: are in effect on October 24, 1992; or
have been in effect prior to October 24, 1992.

tree.heading: Report to Congress
tree.text: Not later than 18 months after October 24, 1992, the Secretary shall transmit to the Congress,1 the results of such study to be accompanied by recommendations for legislation, if any.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The study shall identify and quantify the direct and indirect subsidies and other legal and institutional factors that influence decisions in the marketplace concerning fuels and energy technologies.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $500,000 for each of the fiscal years 1993 and 1994.
